props.description: The poem is read a second time — visualise this as an echo chamber. The poem text from the first reading ghosts behind in deep grey, slightly blurred and offset; the current line surfaces in crisp white above it, as if the words are remembering themselves. A slow radial pulse (like a sound wave) expands outward from each new line as it lands. The effect is intimate and recursive: a voice returning to its own words and finding them heavier the second time through.
